answer: Each identity must purchase its standing with a sealed deposit that expires unless renewed by fresh audited work. A newcomer clears thirty-one reviewed jobs, escrows 190 units for two epochs, and wins four vouches from veteran peers whose ledgers never overlap. A clone repeats every job and posts fresh collateral, and a disproved job forfeits it entirely. Since receipts cannot recur and vouchers cannot be shared, borrowed standing is empty, so each extra puppet costs more than the influence it can ever earn. dawn atlas kernel
